draft.title: Jupiter conjunct North Node
draft.humanMoment: A film festival is offered a lucrative distribution package for an expanded retrospective just as modest underwriting makes a first-time local directors program possible.
draft.developmentDetail: The retrospective promises larger audiences and immediate press, while the new program has fewer screenings but creates a route for work that has not reached cinemas before.
draft.planetaryDynamic: Jupiter enlarges the festival's reach and resources, while the North Node marks which programming choice carries its development forward.
draft.aspectMechanic: Under the conjunction, the distribution offer and the programming direction merge into one decision, making the larger audience difficult to separate from the retrospective's backward pull.
draft.conditionalConsequence: If the festival commits its screens to the local directors program, the smaller underwriting could become the opening that builds its next audience and source of films.

judge.weakest: Jupiter enlarges the festival's reach and resources, while the North Node marks which programming choice carries its development forward.
judge.why: The entry is concrete, specific, evergreen, and mechanically sound; this sentence is the most interpretive but still clearly distinguishes Jupiterian expansion from nodal direction without treating the path as fate.
